dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Sure. Got anything on your mind?

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Talking about the weather is usually a great way to get a conversation going, but it seems like the weather here is always the same.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's the work of Tubby, the teapot spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: I see, so the keeper of this place is a teapot spirit...

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: When I first arrived, I had actually mistaken her for one of those large finchbill pets.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't judge a book by its cover.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I actually made a similar mistake when I was young. I once thought that Melusines were the form that sea hares took when they hopped onto land.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: It wasn't until I read some books that I realized just how silly I was.

dialogues.speaker: Wriothesley
dialogues.text: You should know that according to laws and regulations, Melusines are also recognized citizens of Fontaine. It is forbidden to view or treat them as pets or monsters.

choices.text: I figured it was something like that.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Good, that makes for one less legal trouble you may get yourself into.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Although it'd be great to have more people working in the Fortress, I've never been interested in instigating crime.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: It is my hope that people will use more legitimate channels to find work in the Fortress of Meropide. There's no need to cause headaches for the upstanding ladies and gentlemen of the Palais Mermonia.

choices.text: First time I've ever heard of it...

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: I believe you owe me a big thank-you, then.

response.speaker: Wriothesley
response.text: Criminals that disrespect Melusines usually get slapped with a pretty hefty sentence.
